title: BusinessPackPayload
description:
The payload of a `business_pack` artifact: a composition pack
(`packKind: "composition"`, or omitted by IR `0.1` packs; `provides`,
`artifacts`), an ontology pack (`packKind: "ontology"`; `sources`,
`terms`, `mappings`, `shapes`) or a link pack (`packKind: "link"`;
`fromPack`, `toPack`, `correspondences`, `residuals`).

CompositionPackKind.description: The only `packKind` literal of a composition pack.

CompositionPackRoot.description: A composition pack: the exact artifact versions that ship together.

artifacts.description: Non-empty list of the pack's artifacts.

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

instances.description: Declarations in the retained scoped graph; omitted when there are none.

packKind.description: Omitted by IR `0.1` composition packs; newly authored packs emit it.

typeParameters.description: PACK-BIND-1: named interface slots supplied by every concrete instance.

CorrespondenceRelation.description: How a source term relates to its target terms.

oneOf.description: Same meaning and extension.
Every instance of the source term is an instance of the target term.
Every instance of the target term is an instance of the source term.
The source term's value is a function of the target terms.

DecimalLiteral.description:
An exact decimal number written as a JSON string: an optional `-`, an
integer part without leading zeros, and an optional fraction
(`"0"`, `"-12"`, `"19.990"`). No exponent, no `+`.

Trailing fraction zeros are kept: they carry the literal's scale.

DimensionPath.description: A property reached by zero or more declared directional link roles.

links.description: Forward or inverse roles, in traversal order; empty means the root object.

EnumValue.description: One declared value of an `enum` property.

value.description: The stored value; stable once published.

InterpretationEndpoint.description: Exact Norn1 semantic envelope identity of an interpretation endpoint.

artifactId.description: Retained artifact, resolved without namespace inference.

IrVersion01.description:
The only IR `0.1` version literal of the connector, widget, customization,
policy, derived, and setting roots and of ontology business packs.

LinkId.description:
A role name of a link: the link id on the source type, or the inverse
on the target type. Same grammar as a property id
([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]); properties, links, and inverse roles share one
member name space per object type.

LinkResidual.description: A source term the link does not map.

LinkedPack.description: One linked pack, pinned by its artifact id and exact artifact version.

Member.description:
A member of a definition. Names are the IR's own: an object type or
interface name, a property, link, lifecycle-property, or transition id,
an object-map id, a law id.

oneOf.description: The artifact as a whole (an action, a decision, a mapping).
An object type or interface.
A property of a type.
A link of a type.
A state of a type's lifecycle (a value of its lifecycle property).
A declared transition of a type's lifecycle.
An object map of a mapping.
A law.

MemberRef.description: A member of one exact artifact.

ObjectTypeName.description:
Qualified name of an object type: dotted lower-case namespace segments and
a PascalCase type name (`retail.Sku`, `hr.Employee`), the form v1
`objectKind` already uses. The namespace segments are the type's domain
namespace ([`Self::domain`]).

OntologyLinkKind.description: The only `packKind` literal of a link pack.

OntologyLinkRoot.description:
A link pack: checked correspondences from the terms of one ontology pack
(`fromPack`) to the terms of another (`toPack`). Every active term of the
source pack is accounted for, by a correspondence or a residual
(registry rule).

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

fromPack.description: The pack whose terms are mapped.

residuals.description: Source terms with no correspondence, and why.

toPack.description: The pack the terms map into.

OntologyMapping.description: A reviewed mapping from a Norn term to an external IRI of a pinned source.

ratifiedAt.description:
When the mapping was ratified: a UTC RFC 3339 string, required on
`exact_match` mappings and optional on the other relations (checker
rule).

ratifiedBy.description:
Who ratified the mapping: a non-empty string, required on
`exact_match` mappings and optional on the other relations (checker
rule).

supersededByMappingId.description: Names a mapping of the same term and source in the pack.

OntologyPackKind.description: The only `packKind` literal of an ontology pack.

OntologyPackRoot.description: An ontology pack: a closed-world, semantic-only ontology profile.

extensions.description: Reserved extension slots keyed by `<name>/<semver>`; `null` is rejected.

mappings.description: Non-empty; reviewed mappings from terms to external IRIs.

shapes.description: Non-empty; one closed promotion shape per active shaped term.

OntologyShape.description: A closed promotion shape for one active term.

OntologyShapeField.description: One field of an ontology shape.

OntologySource.description: A pinned upstream source release of an ontology pack.

files.description:
Required (non-empty) for vendored sources. A source the pack imports
or maps from is content-pinned: by these hashes or by a commit or
hash in `releaseId` (checker rule).

importMode.description: How the pack uses the source (norn#56 source manifest).

importer.description:
The importer that read the source. Required for `import` (checker
rule); a reviewed hand mapping has none.

releaseId.description: A strict immutable version, dated-standard release, or content pin.

sourceId.description: In the lowercase `source.*` namespace, unique within the pack.

OntologySourceFile.description:
A hash-pinned file of a source: a repository path for vendored files,
or the absolute HTTPS URL of the pinned bytes otherwise.

parentTermId.description: Resolves within the pack to a compatible, acyclic parent.

supersededBy.description: Required exactly on `superseded` terms; names an active term.

termId.description: An opaque lowercase `norn.*` identifier, unique within the pack.

OntologyTermKind.description:
What an ontology term denotes. `class`, `value_object` and
`concept_scheme_root` terms take one closed promotion shape; `property`,
`action` and `predicate` terms are vocabulary handles and take none.

oneOf.description: A business operation on its domain class (posting an invoice).
A condition over canon state, such as an admission refusal.

OntologyTermStatus.description: Lifecycle status of an ontology term.

PackArtifactKind.description: Artifact kinds a composition pack may contain (not `derived`).

oneOf.description: A discovered source schema included in a mapping pack.
An interface-scoped source-to-Core mapping.
Scoped temporal law.

PackArtifactRef.description: One exact artifact version in a composition pack.

PackInstance.description:
A scoped declaration; imports and contained instances reference this same model.
Identity survives release upgrades. Structural admission grants no execution authority.

typeUnitBindings.description: Compile-time substitutions, independent of governed runtime settings.

PackInstanceRef.description: PACK-PIN-1: an opaque instance identity, pinned separately from its release.

PackTypeUnitBinding.description: A concrete type and every same-group Decimal contract, independently pinned.

decimals.description:
Each source Decimal-binding property names its exact concrete contract.
CurrencySource stays separate from UnitRef.

PropertyConstraints.description:
Constraints on the values of a property type.

Applicability (checked by `norn-checker`): `min`/`max` apply to `integer`
and `decimal`; `minLength`/`maxLength`/`pattern` apply to `text`;
`nullable` applies to every kind. Through a `ref` they apply to the
referenced type's kind.

maxLength.description: Maximum length in Unicode scalar values.

minLength.description: Minimum length in Unicode scalar values.

nullable.description:
Whether a value may be absent (`null`). Defaults to `false`; the
canonical form omits `false`.

pattern.description:
A regular expression the value must contain a match for (JSON Schema
`pattern` semantics: unanchored; write `^…$` for a full match). The
dialect is `regex-lite`, the ZEN Expression pure profile's engine.

PropertyId.description: Id of a property within its object type (`sku_code`), unique there.

PropertyType.description: The value kind of a property, tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: A Unicode string, optionally in a well-known [`TextFormat`].
A signed 64-bit integer.

An exact decimal with a fixed number of fraction digits, optionally a
quantity in a declared unit.

currencySource.description:
Authoritative currency path relative to the object holding this amount.
Monetary decimals declare this instead of a quantity unit. Metrics
must verify this source; descriptions and names carry no semantics.

perUnit.description: VAL-RATE: currency per this unit, distinct from a quantity's `unit`.

rounding.description: VAL-ROUND: explicit store/rescale mode; omission means exact/refuse.

scale.description:
Fraction digits every value is held at (`2` for cents). At most 28,
the exact range of ZEN Expression's decimal (checked by
`norn-checker`).

oneOf.description: VAL-DECIMAL-BIND-1: interface-only exact Decimal: this group shares the implementor's explicit unit and scale.

group.description: Same-name members in one interface bind identically.

oneOf.description: `true` or `false`.
An instant in time with an explicit timezone policy.

timezone.description: How the offset is held. Required: there is no ambient timezone.

oneOf.description: An ISO 8601 calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) with no time and no zone.

An exact elapsed duration (fixed-length units only; calendar periods
such as months are not durations).
One of a closed set of string values.

values.description: Declared values, in presentation order; unique and non-empty.

oneOf.description:
A closed structured value. Every member is present; nullability of
the containing property applies to the whole record.

Opaque JSON (an extension payload), optionally described by a JSON
Schema document the checker does not interpret.
The shared property type (local or registry) with this name.

PropertyTypeName.description:
Dotted, lower-case name of a shared property type, for example
`commerce.sku_code` or the registry value type `iso4217.currency_code`.

Grammar (checked by `norn-checker`): one or more `.`-separated segments,
each `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`.

RecordMember.description:
One required member of a closed record. A nullable member must still be
present, with an explicit null when it has no value.

constraints.description: Constraints on this required member, including its nullability.

id.description: Unique member name, using the property id grammar.

type.description: Inline member kind or a reference to a shared property type.

ResidualReason.description:
Why a source term has no correspondence (norn-platform#2986; lead
ruling 2026-10-31 for `non_conforming`).

oneOf.description: Detail specific to the source system; the canon drops it.
The target lacks a term for it; the canon should grow one.

Source behaviour that breaks a target law (editing posted data in
place). The law holds; the link flags the behaviour and never maps it.

Rounding.description: FOLD-ARITHMETIC / VAL-ROUND: a rounding site declares its mode explicitly.

SemanticAuthority.description: Ontology terms are semantic only: they never grant mutation authority.

ShapeValueType.description: Value types of an ontology shape field.

SourceImportMode.description:
How a pack uses one of its sources.

`import` takes content into the pack's own terms, so its licence must
permit redistribution. `map_only` only maps Norn terms to the source; no
source content enters the pack (the clean-room mode for copyleft and
API-terms sources). `study_only` informs review; no mapping may cite it.

SourceImporter.description: The importer that read a source: an id and its strict version.

SourceRedistribution.description: Whether a source is only referenced or vendored into the repository.

TermCorrespondence.description: One checked correspondence from a source-pack term to target-pack terms.

evidenceRefs.description:
Non-empty; at least one names a mapped source of `fromPack`'s
manifest (`source.*`), the others are absolute HTTPS IRIs.

rulingRef.description: The ruling that settled a divergence this correspondence resolves.

toTermIds.description: Active terms of `toPack`: exactly one, or one or more for `derived`.

transformRef.description:
The `mapping` artifact that executes a `derived` correspondence, when
one exists. The correspondence is semantic either way.

TextFormat.description: Well-known string formats of a `text` property.

oneOf.description: An RFC 5322 address (`addr-spec`).
An RFC 3986 URI.
An RFC 9562 UUID in its hyphenated text form.

TimezonePolicy.description:
A timestamp's declared source-offset policy. Both policies require an
RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset; neither admits a local
date-time. Runtime storage canonicalizes both to UTC (#3112); raw source
observations retain the original offset as source evidence.

oneOf.description: An instant normalized to UTC (`Z`); the source offset is not kept.

Source data supplies an offset. The runtime stores the instant in UTC;
the original source representation belongs to raw observations.

UnitRef.description:
A reference to a unit of measure in a standard unit vocabulary (ruling
2026-09-25 §27). The code is not interpreted here; resolving it against the
vocabulary is registry work (T8-STD-1).

oneOf.description: The Unified Code for Units of Measure (case-sensitive codes).
A QUDT unit (`unit:` local name).

WholeNumber.description:
A non-negative integral JSON number.

IR JSON numbers are binary64 ([`JsonValue::Number`]), so a count written
as `3` and one decoded as `3.0` are the same value. This accepts any
integral, non-negative number up to 2^53 (the exact-integer range of
binary64), matching the validators' `fract() == 0.0` checks; each member's
lower bound stays a checker rule.
